result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional, but there are a few visual issues: horizontal content truncation in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right edge) and a partially visible category chip on the far right. These are typical carousel affordance issues but the truncated card text looks visually broken without a clear scroll hint.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge with its title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator or fade-out affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge gradient fade or partial-card peek with a clear scroll hint so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable; ensure truncated titles use an ellipsis gracefully.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') shows a partially clipped chip at the far right edge with no scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Provide a subtle edge fade or chevron to indicate the chip list scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: The notification bell icon relies only on a small red dot to convey unread status, with no text label or badge count, which may be unclear for screen reader and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and consider a numeric badge for clarity.
